session_lifecycle: The host FastAPI lifespan must enter the MCP server session_manager directly. Mounted ASGI sub-application lifespan execution is not relied upon.
tool_failure_boundary: Expected OperationError values preserve their stable public code. Any other Exception raised inside a tool implementation is logged server-side and converted to retryable runtime_internal_error without exception text, repository paths, secrets, or partial campaign truth.
write_uncertainty_rule: An unexpected execute failure never authorizes replay with a different request. The exact canonical command/request id remains the only safe retry so an already-committed receipt can be recovered idempotently.
authority_rule: Transport recovery never reconstructs campaign truth and never substitutes cached chat state for runtime reads.
verification: mounted host lifespan enters and exits session_manager.run
unexpected read implementation exception returns structured runtime_internal_error
existing MCP initialize, tools/list, OAuth, preview attestation, and duplicate receipt regressions remain routed
